package net.runelite.client.plugins.microbot.kspaiofighter;

/** Dependency-free regression for instant, single-flight High Alchemy. */
public final class KspAioFighterHighAlchGateTest
{
    private static void check(boolean condition, String message)
    {
        if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(message);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        KspAioFighterHighAlchGate gate = new KspAioFighterHighAlchGate();
        check(gate.inspect(0, 1_000, 100_000L) == KspAioFighterHighAlchGate.Decision.READY,
                "First eligible item must cast immediately");

        gate.dispatched(1623, 3, 1_000, 100_000L);
        check(gate.inspect(3, 1_000, 100_200L) == KspAioFighterHighAlchGate.Decision.WAIT,
                "Do not fire a second alch before acknowledgement");
        check(gate.inspect(2, 1_000, 101_000L) == KspAioFighterHighAlchGate.Decision.COOLDOWN,
                "A confirmed alch must allow combat while the spell cools down");
        check(gate.inspect(2, 1_000, 102_401L) == KspAioFighterHighAlchGate.Decision.COOLDOWN,
                "OSRS High Alch still requires a five-tick (3s) spell cooldown");
        check(gate.inspect(2, 1_000, 103_001L) == KspAioFighterHighAlchGate.Decision.READY,
                "Alching should resume at the next legal 3s boundary");

        gate.dispatched(1623, 2, 1_000, 104_000L);
        check(gate.inspect(2, 1_065, 104_600L) == KspAioFighterHighAlchGate.Decision.COOLDOWN,
                "Magic XP acknowledgement must allow combat even if inventory snapshot lags");
        check(gate.trackedItemId() == -1, "Acknowledged cast no longer blocks combat");
        check(gate.inspect(2, 1_065, 107_001L) == KspAioFighterHighAlchGate.Decision.READY,
                "Confirmed cast should allow next spell after cooldown");

        gate.reset();
        for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++)
        {
            long now = 200_000L + attempt * 6_000L;
            check(gate.inspect(1, 2_000, now) == KspAioFighterHighAlchGate.Decision.READY,
                    "Retry may start after prior timeout");
            gate.dispatched(5555, 1, 2_000, now);
            check(gate.inspect(1, 2_000, now + 2_000L) == KspAioFighterHighAlchGate.Decision.WAIT,
                    "Failed cast must not be spam-clicked");
        }
        long failureTime = 217_000L;
        check(gate.inspect(1, 2_000, failureTime) == KspAioFighterHighAlchGate.Decision.BACK_OFF,
                "Three failed casts should back off");
        check(gate.isBackedOffItem(5555, failureTime), "Backoff should target failed item only");
        check(!gate.isBackedOffItem(6666, failureTime),
                "Other eligible items should not be blocked");
        check(gate.inspect(1, 2_000, failureTime + 29_000L) == KspAioFighterHighAlchGate.Decision.BACK_OFF,
                "Maintain 30s failure backoff");
        check(gate.inspect(1, 2_000, failureTime + 30_100L) == KspAioFighterHighAlchGate.Decision.READY,
                "Recover after failure cooldown");

        gate.reset();
        check(gate.trackedItemId() == -1, "Reset clears in-flight work");
        check(gate.inspect(0, 2_000, 300_000L) == KspAioFighterHighAlchGate.Decision.READY,
                "Restart must not inherit cooldown");
        System.out.println("PASS: High Alch priority gate, acknowledgement, cooldown, and bounded retries");
    }
}
